01 Editor's Letter

A Note From Salim Alpha

Salim AlphaFounder & Publisher

Welcome to The Alpha Standard.

My name is Salim Uneze Rutagengwa, known professionally as Salim Alpha. I am the founder of Alpha Coaching, Alpha Adventures, and Alpha Community.

The Alpha Standard was created to document a philosophy that extends beyond fitness. While physical transformation remains at the foundation of what we do, our mission has always been larger than training sessions and workouts. We believe that discipline, personal growth, meaningful relationships, adventure, and service to others are all part of building a stronger life.

Through Alpha Coaching, we help people transform their health and performance. Through Alpha Adventures, we create experiences that challenge comfort zones and encourage exploration. Through Alpha Community, we bring together individuals committed to growth, connection, and positive impact.

Whether you discovered Alpha through fitness, adventure, community, or conversation — I hope this inspires you to pursue excellence in every area of your life.
